learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One sturdy travel backpack in three-quarter view, rolled top, side bottle pocket, two broad padded straps and a clear carry handle.
Confident dark outline only. Simple unpatterned fabric, smooth single seams, no stitching dashes, tiny zipper teeth, logos, or gray shadows. All straps clearly attach to the bag, no extra loose cords. Complete object on empty white, with generous margins.
